items.briefing:
Two alleged members of the cybercriminal group "TeamPCP" have been arrested in Australia, a reminder that cyber threats can originate locally as well as overseas. Separately, Bitdefender is warning of school-themed scams targeting the Asia-Pacific region, including Australia — these typically impersonate schools or education providers to steal personal or financial information, making them particularly relevant as the school term continues.

Be cautious of any unexpected emails or messages claiming to be from schools or educational institutions asking for payments or personal details. When in doubt, call the organisation directly using a number you already know.

featured.title: Abnormal AI adds email controls & phishing training
featured.summary: Businesses face broader email risk as Abnormal adds outbound data-loss controls and adaptive phishing training to its security platform.
